name: Lawrence
source:
Servant to the Jorcastle family and loyal attendant to Miss Lynna. He accompanies Miss Lynna to wherever she may go. Any person who tries to do Miss Lynna harm will automatically become his enemy. Is there a possibility of befriending him?

[From [url=https://helix-waltz.fandom.com/wiki/Lawrence]Helix Waltz Wiki[/url]]
